title: fix(cli): os package publish sends visibility only when --visibility is passed
body:
Part of #20892
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`os package publish` now sends `visibility` in the package upsert only when `--visibility` was passed.

- `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts`
  - The `--visibility` flag loses its `default: 'org'`. An omitted flag is an omitted key in the `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages` body.
  - The summary's `Visibility` line reads the control plane's answer (`pkg.visibility`), else the value this publish explicitly asked for. With neither, it prints `not reported by the control plane`. It never prints `undefined`, and it never reads a local default.
  - The "visibility is marketplace but the version is still draft" hint reads that same value, not the flag. It now also fires when a `marketplace` package is re-published without the flag.
  - Help text: the flag says what omitting it does, and `--submit` states its precondition as the package's visibility, not the flag.
- `packages/cli/test/package-publish-visibility.test.ts`: the pins (below).
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` and `publish-and-preview.mdx`: the `--visibility` rows drop "default `org`" and say the control plane decides when the flag is omitted. The `--submit` row in `cli.mdx` is also updated; see Acceptance notes ③.
- `.changeset/20892-publish-visibility-when-asked.md`: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

**Consumer seam, not changed here:** objectstack-ai/cloud `POST /api/v1/cloud/packages` (`packages/service-cloud/src/routes/package-publish.ts`). For an existing package it sets visibility whenever the body carries one. For a new package it applies an absent value as `org` (cloud ADR-0007 decision ②, as the `repo:cloud` seat reads it). This PR relies on both behaviours and edits neither.

**Scope held to the producer half.** The spec's `PackageSchema.visibility.default('private')` is not touched. It conflicts with ADR-0006 v4 open question 2 and with the shipped `org`, and that question stays with #20900, which remains open. A new package created without the flag still gets `org` from the route, as before, so this PR decides nothing there.

## Repro (before) and the same probe after

This uses the real CLI source entry, `packages/cli/bin/run-dev.js package publish ARTIFACT --server http://127.0.0.1:PORT --token T`. The target is a local capture server that applies the upsert semantics the card measured, with the package pre-stored as `marketplace`.

| | upsert body captured | stored after |
|---|---|---|
| before (`33b6e8bece`), no flag | `{"manifest_id":"com.acme.visprobe","display_name":"Vis Probe","visibility":"org"}` | `org` |
| before, `--submit` | same body, then `submit_for_review: true` | `org` |
| after (`4ecc5a3cd6`), no flag | `{"manifest_id":"com.acme.visprobe","display_name":"Vis Probe"}` | `marketplace` |
| after, `--submit` | no `visibility`, then `submit_for_review: true` | `marketplace` |
| after, `--visibility org` | `...,"visibility":"org"}` | `org` |

The "before" body is byte-identical to the one the cloud seat captured on the card.

## Pins (`test/package-publish-visibility.test.ts`, unit tier)

1. The upsert body has no `visibility` key when the flag is absent.
2. The flag value is carried for each of `private` / `org` / `marketplace` (and `CreatePackageRequestSchema.visibility` accepts it).
3. Re-publishing a stored `marketplace` package without the flag leaves it `marketplace`. The summary prints `marketplace` and the draft hint fires.
4. Control: the same re-publish with `--visibility org` moves the package to `org`. This shows the stand-in can demote, so pin 3 is not vacuous.
5. Creating without the flag yields the route's default (`org`), and the summary prints the route's answer.
6. When neither the flag nor the answer names a visibility, the summary says `not reported by the control plane`, never `undefined`.
7. `--submit` without the flag sends `submit_for_review: true`, sends no `visibility`, and is not refused client-side. There is no client-side precondition on the flag: PM mechanism assumption 3 measured false, and the server judges the stored value.

The stand-in route models only the two route facts the card's cloud seat read and measured. Every pass/fail assertion is about what the CLI sent or printed.

## Verification (all at `4ecc5a3cd6`)

- **Ablation.** The fix was committed first. Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, with a trap-armed restore. The subject is imported from `src/` by a relative path, so no `dist/` leg applies.
  - A: body always carries `flags.visibility ?? 'org'`. 4 red (pins 1, 3, 5, 7), 5 green.
  - B: summary prints `String(visibility)`. 1 red (pin 6).
  - C: hint reads `flags.visibility`. 1 red (pin 3).
  - Each restore was proven: blob == HEAD `4f6c58ac18df` and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Tests.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: 239 files, 3391 tests passed. The six publish-related files alone: 63 of 63. The `integration` tier is declared to CI, since this diff touches no integration-tier file or spawn entry.
- **Typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0. The new test file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFiles`: 1 hit) and adds 0 errors; the 28 ledgered errors in 3 files are unchanged.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 93 derived, 93 run, 0 NOT MEASURED (`--ran` verdict ✓). Three first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-coverage`). After building their prerequisites, all three re-ran with exit 0.
- **Lint.** `pnpm lint` (the full `eslint . --no-inline-config`) exit 0, no output.

## Acceptance notes

① `os plugin publish` (`packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/publish.ts`) has the same shape. Its `--visibility` defaults to `private` and is always sent to the same upsert. The real CLI with no flag captured `{"manifest_id":"com.acme.visprobe","display_name":"Vis Probe","visibility":"private"}`, so re-publishing a `marketplace` plugin without the flag would move it to `private`. That file is outside this claim's file surface, so it is reported to the seat and not changed here.

② The upsert answer's shape is not readable from this repository: the cloud repo is not reachable from this session. Whether the route echoes `visibility` is therefore unmeasured. If it does not, the summary falls back to the explicitly requested value, or prints `not reported by the control plane`.

③ `cli.mdx`'s `--submit` row said "Needs `--visibility marketplace`". This change makes that false: a stored `marketplace` package can now be submitted without the flag. The row now names the package's visibility. This goes one row past the dispatch's "only the `--visibility` rows" and is declared as a deviation.

④ `content/docs/releases/v9.mdx` says the flag "defaults to `org`". Its outcome (new packages get `org`) still holds through the route's default. The page is release-owned and is not edited here. Carrier: none.
